note: Media for features being sold — a modal, a tile, an upsell row, a locked empty state. One entry per feature; every entry has a still, three also have a clip whose first frame IS that still, so it doubles as the poster. A feature not in this set borrows the nearest entry as a placeholder rather than showing a grey box: match on `sells`, prefer kind illustration over slides over product UI, and say so in the handover. See features/README.md.

kinds.illustration: No product UI at all. Never dates, cannot contradict a screen. Safest stand-in.
kinds.slides: Deck imagery only, no app chrome. Safe — content is meant to differ.
kinds.product UI: Real app chrome. Dates with the product and will disagree with a screen drawing today's chrome beside it.
